notes: Stories created for Trial Phase Quality measure covering schema, logic, API exposure, tests, and integration.

EVAL-CT-M1-S1.title: Define Trial Phase Quality Schema and Scoring Contract
EVAL-CT-M1-S1.description: Define a normalized schema for clinical trial phase (I–IV) and a scoring contract that maps phase to a quality score and explanation.

EVAL-CT-M1-S2.title: Implement Trial Phase Extraction and Scoring Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S2.description: Implement logic to extract trial phase from ClinicalTrials.gov response data and map it to a standardized quality score (e.g., Phase I lowest, Phase IV highest) with handling for missing or ambiguous values.

EVAL-CT-M1-S3.title: Expose Trial Phase Quality via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M1-S3.description: Integrate trial phase quality score and explanation into the EvaluateCare facade response so it can be consumed by downstream chat responses.

EVAL-CT-M1-S4.title: Unit Tests for Trial Phase Quality Logic
EVAL-CT-M1-S4.description: Create unit tests validating phase extraction, normalization, scoring mapping, and handling of edge cases such as missing or non-standard phase values.

EVAL-CT-M1-S5.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Trial Phase Quality
EVAL-CT-M1-S5.description: Validate that trial phase quality flows from ClinicalTrials.gov API through domain service, scoring logic, and EvaluateCare facade into final response payload.
